professionalSummary.text: Develops integration services between the MES, plant PLC gateways and the ERP in C# or Java.

experienceHighlights.text: Builds and maintains production dashboards for line stoppages and quality holds.
experienceHighlights.witness: Built Grafana dashboards for line stoppages and quality holds, fed from the MES event tables and used at the plant's morning production meeting.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Writes automated tests for integration services and runs them in the CI pipeline.

skills.text: Works with plant engineers to analyse recurring line faults.
skills.witness: Met the plant engineers monthly to go through the top recurring line faults in the stoppage data and agree which ones needed a software fix.
